summary.headline: Zim Labs Q1 FY27 revenue rose 31.2% YoY to INR 942 mn, but EBITDA margin fell to 3.7% and PAT was minus INR 40 mn, with EU-GMP outcome pending.
summary.overview: Total operating income was about INR 942 million, up 31.2% YoY, with exports at roughly 84% of income. EBITDA was INR 34 million (3.7% margin) and PAT was minus INR 40 million versus minus INR 19 million a year earlier, as higher employee, utility, power and consulting costs weighed. Management said the EU-GMP reinspection (May 2026) is complete, the draft report has no critical observations, and the final report is expected within one to two weeks. Management guided FY27 growth of 10-15% without EU approval and a 30-35% jump in FY28 if EU-GMP and supplies start, but it kept the FY27 EBITDA margin near last year's level.

financial_highlights.change: margin 3.7%; prior-year and prior-quarter margins cited by analysts as ~6-7%
vs minus INR 19 million in Q1 FY26

financial_highlights.metric: NIP + OTF (innovative products) share of income
financial_highlights.change: described as back to normalised contribution

financial_highlights.value: ~INR 1.82 crore (figure restated during call; earlier cited as INR 1.9 crore and INR 1.25 crore)
financial_highlights.change: TGA audit ~INR 30 lakh, MIDC charges, repair and maintenance for EU-GMP

segments.name: Formulations / base business
segments.commentary: Management attributed the strong Q1 to increased formulation business and new relationships and filings; base business expected to keep growing.

segments.name: NIP and OTF (oral thin film, innovative products)
segments.commentary: About 18% of Q1 operating income. Approvals for 8-10 products expected once EU-GMP is granted; most EU filings are near the end of the 210-day clock.

segments.name: R&D / partnered products
segments.commentary: Star product one (enzymatic, UK partner) awaits only EU-GMP before MA. Neuraxpharm buprenorphine MA held by partner, launch delayed pending EU-GMP.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth of 10-15% YoY if EU-GMP is not granted or comes in FY28; management said FY27 will not be flat versus FY26.
FY28 growth of 30-35% (or 30-40% per another remark) if EU-GMP is granted and supplies start; management said at least 60-70% of that growth depends on EU-GMP.
FY27 EBITDA margin expected near last year's level at revenue of INR 410-420 crore; at INR 450-460 crore, margin could reach mid-teens or 13-14%.
Operating leverage expected to kick in above about INR 100 crore revenue, with better margins once costs are absorbed.
Expenses (employee, other) said to be at a fixed run-rate after Q1 one-offs; employee cost run-rate around INR 19 crore per quarter cited by analyst and not disputed.
Capex largely complete; INR 15-20 crore remaining to upgrade enzyme and Nutra plants, projects starting in Q2 FY27.
Debtor days target cut from about 100 to about 80; cost of borrowing said to be below 10%.
capex_capacity: EU-GMP reinspection by German and Portuguese authorities in May 2026 is complete; final report awaited, CAPA ready to submit on receipt.
Australia TGA audit in April 2026; final report received, CAPA submitted and under assessor review; certificate expected in coming months.
Remaining capex of INR 15-20 crore for enzyme plant and Nutra plant upgrades, projects starting in Q2.
Some API inventory being built ahead of approvals for products with scarce API; otherwise just-in-time production.
An alternate site is manufacturing a couple of products as risk mitigation; batches under stability, supplies once stability completes. Management said in-house manufacturing remains primary.
demand_pricing: First supplies to Australia expected in the next two to three months for one product; Australian market for that product about USD 20 million with few players.
Management expects supplies to Europe in Q4 FY27 if the EU-GMP certificate arrives in August, with about two quarters' lag to revenue.
Management said an impact from Middle East disruption was seen in Q1 but was stabilising.
Management said it had 2-3 OTF players in India and few in Europe; holds EU approvals for sildenafil and rizatriptan OTF products.
Neuraxpharm (buprenorphine) partner plans UK launch once EU-GMP is restored.

qa_highlights.question: Are the Q1 expenses (other expenses ~INR 33-34 crore a quarter, higher employee cost) a new normal or one-offs?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the one-time items (TGA audit, MIDC charges, repair and maintenance, about INR 1.8-1.9 crore) will not recur and the expense run-rate is now fixed, with a few hires still pending.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the gross margin of 58.1% higher than the usual 55-56%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said product mix drove the Q1 level and the normal range is 55-58%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the EU-GMP status, and are there major observations?
qa_highlights.answer: The draft report has no critical observations, but there are some major and minor ones. Management said the CAPA alone should be enough for recertification, with no reinspection.

qa_highlights.question: How quickly will sales follow EU-GMP approval, and what growth is expected in FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about two quarters of lag, with supplies starting in Q4, and 30-35% FY28 growth with EU-GMP. Growth without EU is 10-15%. About 60-70% of growth is attributed to EU.

qa_highlights.question: Will the 8-10 EU MAs need refiling if EU-GMP is delayed?
qa_highlights.answer: No refiling is needed unless the delay goes beyond three to four months. The MA depends on a valid EU-GMP certificate, and the 210-day procedure is near its end.

qa_highlights.question: Can margins be double digit at about INR 500 crore revenue, and what are the non-EU economics?
qa_highlights.answer: At INR 410-420 crore margins stay near last year's level. At INR 450-460 crore management said margins would be mid-teens or 13-14%. Q2 results will show whether FY27 overshoots INR 420 crore.

risks_watch: Timing of the EU-GMP final report and CAPA acceptance; management said it could take two to three months after the report for approval, and any delay beyond three to four months may require MA refiling.
Q1 EBITDA margin of 3.7% and PAT loss; investors questioned low ROE (below 5% historically) against a cost of capital around 10%.
Debt of INR 145.2 crore with high debtor days (about 100), and a target to reduce them to about 80.
Dependence on NIP/OTF revenue ramp and on 8-10 EU approvals; partner launches (UK star product, Neuraxpharm) depend on EU-GMP.
Middle East disruption; management said there was an impact in Q1 that appeared to be stabilising.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the EU-GMP outcome and FY28 growth, but cautious and sometimes evasive on near-term margins and revenue, which management tied to Q2 results. Several answers were vague on numbers, such as the FY28 INR 500 crore question, which was not confirmed.
key_quotes: So, we believe that if without EU, if we look at INR 410-420 number, we would have EBITDA margin similar to last year because of the increased costs.
It's about timing now. So, hopefully, that will come soon enough, and then we can start getting the revenues from EU.
There are no adverse observations. There is no critical observations, which is what is important.
Obviously, if it goes beyond three to four months, it'll have to be redone.

adds.what: Remaining INR 15-20 crore upgrade of enzyme plant and Nutra plant (upgrade, not new capacity)

growth.why: Management guides FY27 revenue growth of 10-15% without EU-GMP (INR 410-420 crore implied) and 30-35% in FY28 if EU-GMP and supplies start, backed by partial specifics: EU-GMP reinspection complete with final report pending, Australia supplies in 2-3 months, EU supplies in Q4 FY27 if certificate arrives in August, and only INR 15-20 crore of remaining capex, with no quantified capacity addition.
